atomic_facts.fact: The full legal name of Volkswagen AG is Volkswagen Aktiengesellschaft.
Volkswagen AG's headquarters is located in Wolfsburg, Germany.
As of 2026-10-01, Oliver Blume is the Chief Executive Officer of Volkswagen AG.
Oliver Blume's new five-year agreement/term as CEO is effective 1 January 2026 (running to the end of 2030).
Volkswagen AG agreed to plead guilty to three criminal felony counts related to the diesel emissions cheating scheme.
The guilty plea and penalties were announced on 11 January 2017.
Volkswagen AG agreed to pay $4.3 billion in criminal and civil fines/penalties.
U.S. authorities extracted $25 billion in fines, penalties, civil damages and restitution from Volkswagen for the diesel emissions scandal.
This $25 billion figure was reported on 6 February 2018.
Volkswagen AG has been fined over US$30 billion for using defeat devices to evade/deceive emissions regulations.
